title: `AND`, `OR`, `NOT` are Kleene
description: All nine pairs give Kleene's tables (`NULL AND FALSE` FALSE, `NULL OR TRUE` TRUE). `BOOLAND_AGG` and `BOOLOR_AGG` skip NULLs and are NULL over NULLs only. There is no `IS TRUE`; `COALESCE(x, FALSE)` stands for it.

provenance.checked_by: sverify_dev.probe_snowflake through the Snowflake CLI (Snowflake characterization session)

evidence.sql: SELECT a, b, a AND b, a OR b, NOT a, a = b, a IS DISTINCT FROM b, equal_null(a, b), coalesce(a, FALSE) FROM (VALUES (TRUE, TRUE), (TRUE, FALSE), (TRUE, NULL::BOOLEAN), (FALSE, TRUE), (FALSE, FALSE), (FALSE, NULL::BOOLEAN), (NULL::BOOLEAN, TRUE), (NULL::BOOLEAN, FALSE), (NULL::BOOLEAN, NULL::BOOLEAN)) AS s(a, b)
evidence.observed: (True, True, True, True, False, True, False, True, True); (True, False, False, True, False, False, True, False, True); (True, NULL, NULL, True, False, NULL, True, False, True); (False, True, False, True, True, False, True, False, False); (False, False, False, False, True, True, False, True, False); (False, NULL, False, NULL, True, NULL, True, False, False); (NULL, True, NULL, True, NULL, NULL, True, False, False); (NULL, False, False, NULL, NULL, NULL, True, False, False); (NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, False, True, False)

provenance.notes: `sverify_dev.probe_snowflake` runs each query through `snow sql` (Snowflake CLI 3.32.1) on an X-Small warehouse, Snowflake 10.40.102, with the session's `TIMEZONE` set to UTC and `USE_CACHED_RESULT` off; every other parameter is the account's default, recorded in the header of probes.json (`WEEK_START` 0, `WEEK_OF_YEAR_POLICY` 0, `DEFAULT_NULL_ORDERING` LAST, `TIMESTAMP_TYPE_MAPPING` TIMESTAMP_NTZ). The inputs are literal `VALUES`, except the `sample-*` probes, which read TPC-H's LINEITEM (6,001,215 rows) in SNOWFLAKE_SAMPLE_DATA.
